scene: Steam bursts out, blowing open transit gates along the back wall.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a tiled platform. Far left, a paint-splattered tram waits with open doors. Left of centre, the Pacific Islander girl stands holding her sketchbook beside a steaming brass valve. At centre, a glass revolving door lift sits idle. Right, a red rooftop gondola is tethered to a windy boarding gate.
shown: A paint-splattered tram waiting at an open bay door on the left.
A glass revolving-door lift glowing with arrow indicators at the centre.
A red rooftop gondola swaying at an open boarding platform on the right.
